text.arabic_uthmani: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

words.gloss_range: purpose, result, or benefit particle prefixed to the following imperfect and dependent on the prior provision scene
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens the ayah as a dependent purpose and benefit clause, not as an autonomous new sentence. The eating that follows is grammatically pulled out of the prior provision acts in 36:34, gathering several acts of making, bringing forth, and causing springs into one edible outcome; human appetite is framed as intended result and received benefit before any later mention of hands. Its tight surface attachment to the verb also makes that dependency audible and visible: purpose is not an afterthought added to consumption, but part of the word-shape that launches the ayah.

topics.headline: purpose frames eating as received benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consumption is introduced as a designed and allocated outcome of prior provision, not as independent human initiative.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the prefixed particle as governing the following imperfect inside a purpose clause whose governor lies outside this ayah.

topics.headline: the ayah starts as continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 36:35 is grammatically tied to the gardens and springs of 36:34 before the verse turns to human agency.
topics.reason: The attachment layer marks the purpose clause as dependent on a prior governor and warns that a single-ayah rendering may detach it from the provision acts that license it.

topics.headline: surface fusion makes dependency felt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is encountered as a proclitic bound to the eating verb, so the grammar of dependence is built into the surface.
topics.reason: The QAC segmentation treats the particle as prefixed to the following imperfect, matching the CRITICAL emphasis on visible and audible attachment.

words.gloss_range: to eat or consume, here as repeated human intake governed by the purpose particle and supplied by a partitive source phrase
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, using up, and edible yield; local grammar selects consumption while the surrounding fruit phrase keeps edible-yield pressure nearby
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْكُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:yaʾkulū}}) names human consumption under the prefixed purpose frame. The verb has no direct accusative object; the following source phrase makes the eaters draw from provision rather than possess the yield as a total object. Its plural imperfect form makes this a repeatable communal benefit, and the ayah's later close with the gratitude verb tests whether ongoing use becomes ongoing acknowledgment. As the first lexical verb, it lets bodily need appear before the named fruit source and moves the discourse from prior divine production toward human use; the hamza inside the verb gives that first act of taking food a small catch in recitation. The root's edible-yield field reinforces the tie to the fruit that follows, while the local form remains simple eating, not causative feeding.

topics.headline: repeatable eating is purpose-governed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eating is presented as an ongoing benefit under a prior purpose, not as one completed meal or independent action.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect governed by the prefixed purpose particle, with attachment evidence warning that the purpose clause depends on the prior provision context.

topics.headline: source phrase replaces direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consumption is source-bound and non-totalizing: they eat from the yield rather than grammatically owning or exhausting it.
topics.reason: The verb-instance frame marks no direct object, while the following prepositional phrase supplies the partitive source.

topics.headline: plural consumers remain beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural humans are consumers of provision, not producers of the provision order.
topics.reason: The implicit subject is a plural human group, and the local Form I verb is simple eating rather than causative feeding.

topics.headline: edible-yield pressure stays local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root field links bodily intake with edible yield, while the local verb still selects the act of eating.
topics.reason: V4 supports a root field involving consumption and edible produce, but local grammar keeps the finite verb as the eating action.

topics.headline: eating opens a gratitude test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening act of use is not complete until the closing gratitude question asks for recognition.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows give concrete eating-gratitude associations and the local ayah itself frames the opening consumption with the closing gratitude verb.

topics.headline: first content verb marks need
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first content verb foregrounds human need before the source phrase and later hand-agency clause qualify it.
topics.reason: The verb is positioned before the named fruit source and participates in a same-surah provision thread, while the phonetic observation is consistent with the surface form.

words.gloss_range: source or partitive preposition governing the fruit phrase after an objectless eating verb
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the fruit into a source from which the eaters draw. Because the eating verb has no direct object, this preposition carries the object-like pressure as source and partitive relation: they eat from the yield, not the yield as a possessed totality. It also closes the first source phrase before the conjunctional middle clause, keeping received provision distinct from the later question of human work. The nasal close of {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) binds into the following fruit phrase in recitation, so the source-dependency is heard as well as parsed.

topics.headline: eating is from a source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dependence and non-exhaustive use: the consumers draw from abundance rather than owning the whole yield.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive fruit phrase as the partitive source for the objectless eating verb.

topics.headline: source beat stays distinct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source phrase completes one provision beat before the ayah turns to the disputed work clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence keeps the source phrase inside the purpose clause and distinguishes it from the following coordinated or contrastive clause.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds source to fruit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation can make the dependency between the preposition and fruit phrase felt as a bound source unit.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is compatible with the adjacent preposition-plus-noun sequence and does not overrule the grammar.

words.gloss_range: fruit, produce, or realized yield, here a genitive source noun with a masculine singular possessive suffix whose antecedent remains provision-linked
words.root_gloss_range: fruit, productive yield, multiplied output, and realized return; local usage names edible produce as received yield rather than raw vegetation
words.prose: {{ar:ثَمَرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:thamarihi}}) is the yield from which the eating takes place, not a direct object seized by the eaters. Its suffix keeps the fruit relational to the prior provision scene, with the antecedent deliberately broad enough to carry the gardens, species, and produced yield from 36:34. The root field makes the noun more than inert food: it is realized fruit or return. Accepted vowel readings keep the yield textured as concrete fruit, pluralized produce, or compressed collective output. The fruit phrase also fits wider provision patterns where fruits come through supplied water and call for gratitude (14:32; 14:37; 2:22). Positioned before the work-and-hands clause, the fruit establishes received yield before human agency is evaluated.

topics.headline: suffix carries prior provision forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fruit is grammatically relational, carrying the prior provision scene into the present source phrase.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically forced and its antecedent is marked ambiguous, so the output preserves the provision-linked openness rather than resolving it narrowly.

topics.headline: fruit is source domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fruit functions as the source from which eating draws, not as a possessed accusative object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the noun in genitive relation after the source preposition.

topics.headline: fruit appears as realized yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names an achieved productive return before the ayah admits any claim about human labor.
topics.reason: Dictionary and contextual evidence support fruit and yield senses, while local grammar anchors them in the concrete provision source.

topics.headline: variant vowels texture the yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted readings vary the feel of the same yield between concrete fruit, pluralized produce, and compressed collective output.
topics.reason: QAC notes qiraat vowel variation for this noun, so the CRITICAL variant-texture rows are valid as reading apparatus without changing the local function.

topics.headline: fruit belongs to provision formulae
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this fruit phrase participates in Quranic provision patterns where fruits come through supplied water and call for gratitude (14:32; 14:37; 2:22).
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete references, and nothing in the local grammar blocks using them as provision-pattern parallels.

topics.headline: yield precedes human agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that received yield sets the terms before the sentence introduces work and hands.
topics.reason: The word order places the fruit-source phrase before the middle clause about work and hands, matching the CRITICAL sequence claim.

words.gloss_range: conjunction or circumstantial hinge before the ambiguous middle clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge from fruit-source to the clause about work and hands. It can coordinate the following clause with the fruit phrase, and it can also support a circumstantial contrast when the next particle is read negatively. That means the middle beat is not detached: the same connector routes either included human work or denied human manufacture into the final gratitude question. Its fused surface with the following ambiguous particle makes the interpretive ambiguity arrive through connection, not isolation.

topics.headline: connector scopes over middle clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work-and-hands clause is grammatically tied to the fruit phrase rather than starting an unrelated topic.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction before the following clause, and attachment evidence reads that clause as coordinated or contrastive with the fruit phrase.

topics.headline: hinge can carry contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector can make the middle clause a contrast about what hands did not make, while the relative reading remains available.
topics.reason: The bundle tags the following particle as relative but explicitly notes a plausible negative reading because of the verb form, so the contrast is preserved as a narrowed live option.

topics.headline: fusion routes the ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ambiguous middle particle is encountered only through the attached connector.
topics.reason: The surface segment fuses the conjunction to the following particle, matching the CRITICAL form and sound observations.

topics.headline: pivot from yield to agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from received fruit into the scrutiny of human workmanship.
topics.reason: The conjunction follows the fruit phrase and introduces the clause that attachment evidence links as the contested middle beat.

words.gloss_range: ambiguous particle read as relative pronoun or, with a live narrowed option, as negation before the work verb
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the pivot of the middle clause. As a relative particle, it can add what their hands worked within the provision domain; as a negative particle, it can deny that their hands made the fruit under discussion. The bundle's tag favors the relative analysis, while attachment evidence keeps the negative reading plausible because of the following verb. The open vowels across the connector, particle, and work verb slow the hinge before the hands are named, letting the reparse register in recitation. That ambiguity is the point: the final rebuke can address both beneficiaries whose labor is real and listeners tempted to mistake enabled labor for first authorship.

topics.headline: relative reading includes worked products
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause can include humanly worked products inside provision rather than excluding labor from the scene.
topics.reason: The QAC bundle tag identifies the particle as a relative pronoun, and the following verb can supply the relative clause.

topics.headline: negative reading denies authorship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface can rebuke overclaim by denying that human hands authored the provision itself.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly notes a plausible negative-particle reading because of the following verb, but the relative tag prevents making negation the sole local parse.

topics.headline: one form supports two parses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ambiguity is created by the same visible form, not by swapping in a different word.
topics.reason: The surface is invariant while the local syntax allows relative and negative analyses to remain in tension.

topics.headline: ambiguity feeds the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final question can judge both readings: real work still owes gratitude, and non-authorship makes ingratitude worse.
topics.reason: The middle clause remains unresolved before the result question, allowing the rebuke to cover both included labor and denied manufacture.

topics.headline: sound slows the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation can let the ambiguous hinge register before the hands are named.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation follows the actual surface sequence and serves the independently supported syntactic ambiguity.

words.gloss_range: worked, did, made, or labored upon, here a perfect verb with an object suffix and delayed broken-plural hand-agent
words.root_gloss_range: deed, work, craft, productive operation, and worked object; local form names actual labor without making it first cause
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلَتْهُ}} ({{tr:ʿamilathu}}) makes work grammatically concrete. The feminine singular verb agrees with the delayed broken-plural hands, and the attached object suffix makes the standard reading explicitly transitive: something has been worked. Yet the clause sits after the fruit-source frame, so human labor is real but downstream. The variant without the object suffix narrows the object and strengthens the possible negative reading of the preceding particle. The perfect aspect places completed work before the ongoing gratitude question, while the plain Form I keeps agency direct rather than causative or seeking. The same work-hands field returns with divine hand-agency at 36:71, sharpening the contrast between enabled human operation and divine production. The root family joins deed, craft, operation, and output, so productive labor becomes part of the gratitude test rather than a neutral technical detail.

topics.headline: work is grammatically concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an explicit worked object and a delayed hand-agent, so labor is grammatically present rather than vague.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the object suffix as direct object and the following hands as subject, while QAC gives the feminine singular agreement.

topics.headline: variant shifts object pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that removing the object suffix changes how strongly the clause supports a negative non-authorship reading.
topics.reason: The local standard form has the object suffix, so the variant is preserved as apparatus that changes parse pressure rather than replacing the main reading.

topics.headline: hands work but not as first cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah acknowledges deliberate human operation while keeping it dependent on prior provision.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence supports labor and operation, while the clause position after the fruit-source frame prevents making labor the first source.

topics.headline: work joins production and accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that productive work is ethically charged by the gratitude question, not treated as craft-neutral.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the root field to deed and labor and connect the local work verb with the closing gratitude demand.

topics.headline: completed work faces ongoing gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completed work stands before an ongoing gratitude question, and the form stays plain rather than causative or seeking.
topics.reason: The local form is perfect Form I with an object suffix, contrasted by CRITICAL rows with the later imperfect gratitude verb.

topics.headline: work and hands form agency pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that operation and instrument stand together locally and recur in a same-surah contrast with divine hand-agency (36:71).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a same-surah contrast at 36:71 and the local grammar confirms the adjacent work-hands relation.

topics.headline: act arrives before agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is heard before the named human instrument, delaying agency inside the contested middle clause.
topics.reason: The word order places the verb before the hand-agent, and the sound row tracks the adjacent object and possessive suffixes without altering the parse.

words.gloss_range: their hands, here the delayed broken-plural hand-agent with a possessive suffix identifying the same human group
words.root_gloss_range: bodily hand with extensions to power, possession, control, favor, and agency; local phrase selects bodily hands as metonymic instruments of accountable human work
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:aydīhim}}) finally names the human instrument after the work verb has already been introduced. The broken plural locks the feminine agreement, and the possessive suffix identifies the hands as theirs, the same plural group that eats and is challenged to give thanks. A y-d-y/y-d-w derivational dispute stays analytical here: it does not change the local hand meaning. The hand root can extend to power and control, but locally the bodily hand remains the selected image, carrying metonymic agency without sovereignty. Its position as the last image before the negative interrogative places human agency directly under the gratitude challenge, while same-surah and cross-surah echoes keep those hands productive but answerable (36:9; 36:65; 36:71; 36:83; 48:10). The adjacent h-sounds between the worked-object suffix and the hands' possessive suffix keep object and agent audibly linked while grammatically distinct.

topics.headline: hands are owned and accountable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hands are grammatical agents and are tied to the same human group that consumes and must answer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as subject of the work verb and the suffix as possessive reference to the plural human group.

topics.headline: broken plural distributes agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many hands gathered under one group rather than a single pair of hands.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as broken plural and the grammar links it to the feminine singular verb agreement.

topics.headline: hand means agency, not sovereignty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bodily hand stands for human agency and capacity while the provision frame blocks treating that capacity as sovereign source.
topics.reason: V4 supports hand, power, and control branches, but local syntax selects the bodily hand as instrument and the ayah's provision frame narrows claims of control.

topics.headline: root dispute stays analytical
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that derivational analysis is live, but it does not change the local hand meaning.
topics.reason: The disputed derivation is valid as analysis, but QAC alignment and local context keep the surface sense as hands.

topics.headline: hands enter an agency motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that these hands belong to a larger agency motif, including same-surah hand scenes and the contrast of human hands beneath divine hand (36:9; 36:65; 36:71; 36:83; 48:10).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah and cross-surah references, and the local phrase is a genuine work-hand pairing.

topics.headline: hands stand before the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human agency is delayed, localized, and then placed as the final image before the gratitude question.
topics.reason: The word appears after the work verb and immediately before the result question, matching the CRITICAL placement claim.

topics.headline: yield, work, and hands form a chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact sequence from yield to operation to instrument, with object and agent kept audibly linked yet distinct.
topics.reason: The grammar distinguishes object suffix and hand-agent while their adjacent suffix sounds support the CRITICAL sound observation.

words.gloss_range: interrogative hamza plus consequential connector introducing the final rebuking question
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) turns the provision-and-agency sequence into a consequential challenge. The hamza abruptly opens interrogation, while the connector makes the question an inference from what has just been displayed rather than a detached moral prompt. At this boundary, description becomes accountability: eating, fruit, work, and hands are now premises for the closing demand for gratitude.

topics.headline: question follows as inference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final question is drawn from the preceding evidence, not added as a free-standing prompt.
topics.reason: QAC identifies interrogative-plus-connector structure, and attachment evidence marks the following clause as the rhetorical result question.

topics.headline: interrogation becomes rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question challenges non-recognition after visible provision rather than seeking information.
topics.reason: The translation-support layer warns against rendering the closing as a plain information question.

topics.headline: description pivots to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact turn where provision evidence becomes a demand for accountable response.
topics.reason: The particle segment stands between the fruit-and-hands chain and the final gratitude verb, matching the CRITICAL transition claim.

topics.headline: hamza sharpens the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abrupt opening of the final challenge as the ayah turns from narrative display to rebuke.
topics.reason: The sound observation follows the visible initial hamza and supports the independently established rhetorical turn.

words.gloss_range: negative particle inside a rhetorical question, scoping over the gratitude verb rather than issuing a prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the final question a rebuke over absent gratitude, not a prohibition. Its scope falls on the gratitude verb, so the fault is not lack of fruit, labor, or consumption, but the failure of response after all three have been displayed. As part of the negative interrogative sequence, the negation is fused to the consequential question: non-gratitude is presented as astonishing in light of the evidence. The short open syllables of that sequence also make a quick cadential lead-in to the heavier closing gratitude verb.

topics.headline: negation targets gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah isolates non-gratitude as the precise fault rather than negating the provision or labor scene.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a negative particle before the imperfect gratitude verb within the interrogative frame.

topics.headline: absence becomes moral failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing response is treated as a morally charged mismeasurement of visible benefit.
topics.reason: The negative interrogative frame is supported by the attachment warning that the closing is a rhetorical result question, not a plain report.

topics.headline: negation is fused to challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar negative-question force arises from the sequence as one closing challenge.
topics.reason: The particle sits between the interrogative segment and the gratitude verb, forming the negative interrogative close.

topics.headline: short cadence sharpens demand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a quick lead-in before the heavier closing gratitude verb.
topics.reason: The sound row describes the actual short particle sequence before the final verb and does not add a separate semantic claim.

words.gloss_range: they give thanks or acknowledge benefit, here an objectless imperfect plural under rhetorical negation
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude, acknowledgment, making benefit visible, active thanking, and intensified gratitude; local form demands direct active acknowledgment, not causative thanking or private feeling alone
words.prose: {{ar:يَشْكُرُونَ}} ({{tr:yashkurūn}}) is the ayah's landing point. It is an imperfect plural under rhetorical negation, so the question tests an ongoing communal posture, not a one-time courtesy. The verb has no explicit object, widening the demanded gratitude beyond one fruit item to the giver, the yield, enabled labor, and the whole provision order. The root field makes gratitude visible acknowledgment of benefit rather than private appreciation only, and the simple active form keeps the demand direct. As the close of the ayah, it answers the opening consumption frame and begins a same-surah gratitude refrain that returns at 36:73; 36:36 then answers demanded acknowledgment with explicit glorification.

topics.headline: gratitude is ongoing and communal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural beneficiaries are being tested for an ongoing communal practice of gratitude.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect plural with an implicit subject matching the eaters and hand-owners, and it sits under the negative interrogative frame.

topics.headline: object omission broadens gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude is not limited to one named item but gathers the whole chain of received and enabled benefit.
topics.reason: The verb-instance frame marks no explicit object, and translation support warns that target languages may be tempted to add one.

topics.headline: gratitude makes benefit visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude is public acknowledgment of benefit, so silent consumption becomes concealment of dependence.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence supports acknowledgment and making benefit visible, and the local negative question demands that response.

topics.headline: form demands direct response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local form asks for active acknowledgment, not causing others to thank or merely having an inward disposition.
topics.reason: The local surface is the simple active imperfect form, while dictionary evidence supplies broader family terms without overriding the selected form.

topics.headline: consumption must become acknowledgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah frames human agency between use at the opening and required acknowledgment at the close.
topics.reason: The local ayah begins with eating and ends with gratitude, and the CRITICAL rows identify this as a consumption-response frame.

topics.headline: gratitude refrain returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this closing formula belongs to a same-surah pattern of benefits followed by a gratitude challenge (36:73), with broader gratitude-increase resonance at 14:7.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references, and the local formula matches the same-surah repetition at 36:73.

topics.headline: the final word measures the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word turns the whole provision chain into a response test and hands forward to performed praise in 36:36.
topics.reason: The verb is the ayah-final word, the same formula recurs later, and the next ayah opens with explicit glorification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins eating, fruit, deliberate work, hands, and the closing question about gratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: Consumable yield arrives at the eater through a productive process that deliberate handwork does not fully originate. Gratitude is the recognition that use and benefit exceed the eater's fabrication.

activation_trace.role: Direct consumption supplies the endpoint at which the productive gift becomes bodily benefit.
Mature tree-yield supplies the produced object whose arrival is being attributed.
Intentional action supplies the human causal contribution against which origination is measured.
Attribution of deeds to the hands makes human agency emphatic rather than merely instrumental.
Recognition of favor supplies the demanded response to correctly attributed benefit.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply asks people to give thanks for food.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks eaters to distinguish using a yield from originating its productivity, and to answer that distinction with gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The work-of-hands clause can be heard alongside, rather than only in negation of, the fruit that is eaten.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the clause is heard relatively, the meal includes both unprocessed yield and transformations made by skilled hands. Human craft remains real, but gratitude locates craft inside a prior field of supplied materials and capacities.

activation_trace.role: Generated benefit broadens fruit from a raw object to an outcome available for further use.
Manual workers supply a concrete image of hands converting available material into usable food.
Artisanal skill makes the hands genuine contributors without making them the source of the whole productive order.
Acknowledged favor prevents skilled processing from becoming a claim of self-sufficient production.

changed_reading.before: Human making and divine gift must be mutually exclusive readings of the clause.
changed_reading.after: The clause can preserve human processing while placing its materials, powers, and successful yield within a gift that still calls for gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Eating is followed immediately by a question using the root whose branches include nourishment becoming visibly productive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gratitude can be more than verbal acknowledgment: as slight feed becomes visible flourishing and fresh growth, received fruit should become a manifested good in the recipient.

activation_trace.role: An allotted edible provision supplies the small input received by the beneficiary.
Fruit as generated benefit supplies the outcome that can be reproduced in conduct.
A little nourishment producing a visible effect makes gratitude a responsive amplification of what was received.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is an inward feeling or spoken acknowledgment after eating.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible fruiting of provision in the recipient, where nourishment issues in further good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context expands fruit into a chain: inert earth is revived, hidden grain emerges, a germinating seed bears, and water bursts from flowing sources. Human hands may cultivate within this chain, but the focus denies them exclusive title to its upstream transitions.

activation_trace.role: Mature yield anchors the context chain back in the focus object that is eaten.
Emphatic hand-attribution marks the human claim whose causal scope the chain limits.
Lifeless land supplies the unproductive starting state before any edible return exists.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation supplies the first nonhuman transition toward yield.
Drawing something out of concealment makes grain an emergence, not a hand-assembled object.
The germinating, grain-bearing seed supplies a self-unfolding material link in the chain.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the enabling release of water into the planted system.
A flowing water source supplies the continuing input that hands neither fabricate nor contain.

structural_cues: Verses 36:33-35 form one contiguous movement from dead earth through grain and irrigated gardens to eating and gratitude.
The upstream transitions are stated before the focus contrasts them with human hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered states of land, life, emergence, seed, and water; I infer a causal arrow from those states to fruit. Human cultivation remains a live intermediate cause, but not the origin of the chain.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is a finished gift placed opposite human manufacture.
changed_reading.after: Fruit is the visible endpoint of a layered living system, so gratitude concerns dependence on upstream transitions even when hands genuinely cultivate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse places what earth grows among created pairings and unknown kinds. The fruit in the focus becomes the visible surface of relational and partly unknown generativity, while hand skill occupies only the observable final layer.

activation_trace.role: Generated benefit anchors the model in fruit as an outcome rather than an isolated object.
Skilled hands supply the visible human layer whose explanatory reach is being bounded.
Originary bringing-into-being supplies a category larger than artisanal transformation.
Joined counterparts supply a relational mechanism by which outcomes arise from more than one visible agent.
Vegetation issuing from earth ties created relationality directly back to the focus fruit.

structural_cues: Verse 36:36 immediately follows the focus and extends its agricultural scene to pairs, selves, and unknown kinds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created pairs, earth-growth, and unknown kinds; I infer that paired and hidden relations help explain the focus yield. The alternative is that the verse catalogs creation without specifying a growth mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The hand clause corrects a simple mistake about who made a visible fruit.
changed_reading.after: The hand clause also demands epistemic modesty: the visible yield condenses relations and unknown processes that skilled handling cannot exhaustively explain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship-and-riding sequence treats an artifact-like utility as carried, created, vulnerable to drowning, and preserved only as mercy and temporary use. By analogy, hand-processed food can be genuinely useful without becoming self-securing or self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work anchors the analogy in real human making and use.
Artisanal hands make the focus compatible with an artifact-like comparison.
Bearing a visible load supplies the enabling function on which passengers depend.
The waterborne vessel supplies the artifact-like object through which utility is mediated.
A filled load makes the vessel's successful capacity concrete rather than merely symbolic.
Originary creation places rideable utility inside supplied possibility.
Actual riding supplies the beneficiary's use, parallel to eating in the focus.
Drowning in water exposes the utility's inability to guarantee its own success.
Merciful preservation supplies the condition under which a made utility continues to benefit.
A useful means for present needs makes enjoyment derivative and time-bounded.

structural_cues: The ship sequence follows the agricultural signs and repeats the pattern of created provision becoming human use.
Use is immediately paired with the possibility of failure and with mercy as preservation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying, riding, drowning, mercy, and temporary use; I transfer that dependency pattern to hand-processed fruit. The live alternative is that transport illustrates only rescue, not the causal status of artifacts.

changed_reading.before: Once hands process a resource, their successful product is straightforwardly theirs.
changed_reading.after: Even a hand-mediated utility remains dependent on supplied capacities, favorable conditions, and preservation; successful use does not establish originary authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to spend from allotted provision, and the refusal to feed on the ground that God could feed directly, block a quietist reading of the focus. Recognizing nonhuman origination must activate human distribution rather than cancel it.

activation_trace.role: Hands as emphatic agents anchor the question of what human agency should do with received yield.
Acknowledging the giver supplies the response that the distribution scene turns into action.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies the required movement of provision beyond its holder.
An allotted gift frames what is held as received distribution rather than absolute possession.
Feeding another supplies the human mediation that the objectors wrongly oppose to divine provision.

structural_cues: Verse 36:47 converts the surah's food-provision language into a command and records a refusal based on a false either-or between divine and human feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received provision, commanded expenditure, and a refusal to feed; I infer that this scene specifies an enacted form of the focus gratitude. The alternative is that it addresses charity independently, but its feeding logic directly tests the same agency distinction.

changed_reading.before: Because hands did not originate the fruit, their proper role is only to acknowledge its giver.
changed_reading.after: Because the fruit is received provision, grateful hands must also circulate it; divine origination intensifies rather than erases human responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Work is later repaid, and hands themselves speak while limbs testify to earnings. The focus therefore distinguishes originary agricultural productivity from moral authorship; it does not dissolve human action into passivity.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the model in action for which a person can remain responsible.
Deeds emphatically attributed to hands create the focus point later turned into testimony.
Action answered by equivalent recompense supplies a strict consequence for human work.
The repeated intentional-work branch confirms that human acts remain genuinely attributable.
Intelligible speech turns the bodily instrument of action into an evidentiary voice.
The same hand-attribution now functions as direct testimony about its owner's deeds.
Informed declaration supplies the legal mechanism by which embodied action is disclosed.
Seeking and obtaining benefit names the acquisitive activity for which the hands bear witness.

structural_cues: Verse 36:54 makes work the basis of recompense.
Verse 36:65 reuses hands as speaking evidence of what people acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompensed work and bodily testimony; I infer a distinction between originating natural yield and authoring accountable choices. The narrower alternative is that the focus negation concerns only this crop, but the later echoes still prevent a general denial of agency.

changed_reading.before: The denial of hand-making minimizes human agency in general.
changed_reading.after: The denial is jurisdictional: hands do not originate the living yield, yet they fully own the moral direction, acquisition, and distribution of their acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later cattle sequence deliberately reassembles creation, work, hands, ownership, facilitated use, eating, benefits, drinking, and the same gratitude question. Human possession and use are affirmed, but they sit beneath a higher making and finally beneath dominion held in another hand.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work anchors the contrast between the focus's human hands and the later maker.
Emphatic hand-attribution supplies the repeated lexical joint that changes whose work is in view.
Eating anchors the later cattle use back in the focus's beneficiary relation.
Recognition of favor supplies the identical evaluative close shared by both scenes.
Originary creation explicitly frames the animals before work and hands are named.
The repeated purposeful-work branch transfers the focus construction to divine agency.
The repeated hand-attribution marks a deliberate contrast in the subject of making.
Livestock as wealth supplies the created asset that humans subsequently possess and use.
Real possession and disposal affirm delegated control without equating it with origination.
Facilitation after difficulty supplies the enabling relation that makes ownership usable.
Repeated direct consumption makes the cattle sequence a functional reprise of the focus.
Benefit opposed to harm widens provision beyond food while preserving the beneficiary structure.
Consumable wealth joins drinking to eating as another return from the created asset.
The repeated gratitude challenge explicitly evaluates this layered ownership and use.
Hand as effective sovereignty supplies the final scale above all delegated human control.
Dominion supplies the closing ownership frame within which every particular possession is nested.

structural_cues: Verses 36:71-73 repeat the focus cluster of work, hands, eating, and the same gratitude question while adding creation and human ownership.
Verse 36:83 closes the surah by joining hand and dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the dense lexical reprise and explicitly affirms human ownership; I infer a contrast between originary making and delegated control. If the focus work-clause is relative rather than negative, the alternative co-production reading survives, but it remains nested under the same higher authorship.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude follows a general contrast between God's gift and things humans make.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude polices a precise hierarchy: people may own, manage, process, and consume, but those valid powers are delegated within a making and dominion they do not possess.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from food consumption to combustion. It remains anchored in the focus eating branch that treats fire as a consumer and in the later green-tree ignition sequence; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy about latent potency, not as a claim that fruit literally denotes fuel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus eating root includes a fire-consumption branch, while fruit names generated benefit.

activation_trace.role: Fire consuming supplied material creates a second kind of eater anchored in the focus verb.
Generated benefit lets plant matter carry more than one latent usable outcome.
The trunked tree supplies the common material source for growth and combustible use.
Fresh green vegetation sharpens the reversal from living moisture to released fire.
Burning fire supplies the hidden energetic yield later drawn from plant matter.
Human ignition supplies a genuine triggering act that releases, but does not originate, the stored potency.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns one-way plant production ending in human eating.
changed_reading.after: The plant can hold several latent yields: humans eat its fruit and can trigger its matter to feed fire, so hand action releases possibilities it did not author.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it renders an ethical response through animal nourishment, milk, and fresh shoots. It remains anchored in multiple focus gratitude branches and is reinforced by grain, benefit, and drink elsewhere in the surah; downstream prose should qualify it as an embodied analogy for manifested response, not a replacement definition of gratitude.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gratitude root carries images of slight feed becoming visible condition, fullness, and new growth.

activation_trace.role: Small nourishment producing a visible effect supplies the core conversion from reception to response.
Fullness and abundant milk supply an image of received pasture becoming shareable surplus.
Fresh shoots supply an outward sign that nourishment has generated further life.
A seed that germinates and bears grain supplies the surah-level pattern of received potential multiplying.
Concrete benefit supplies the positive effect that gratitude should make visible.
Taking in liquid provision reinforces the embodied reception immediately followed by the repeated gratitude question.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude names a statement made after consuming a benefit.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude can be pictured as metabolizing benefit into visible flourishing and shareable surplus, so the recipient becomes a new site of fruiting.

strongest_changes: The immediate earth-to-fruit chain turns the focus object into the endpoint of hidden, upstream living processes rather than a hand-assembled item.
The command to spend and the later testimony of hands distinguish dependence from passivity: received provision creates distributive and moral responsibility.
The 36:71-73 lexical reprise and 36:83 close establish ownership without originary authorship, nesting human control beneath higher making and dominion.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not merely add a broad creation theme. It supplied exact hand, work, eating, ownership, and gratitude reprises that transformed the focus into a layered account of origination, delegated use, accountability, and circulation.
remaining_uncertainties: The polarity or relative force of the focus work-clause remains live, so exclusive non-making and subordinate co-processing should both be carried.
The causal transfer from growth and transport sequences to the focus is a reader inference even though their dependency structures closely align.
The fire-consumption and metabolic-gratitude readings are intentionally exploratory branch analogies and should remain explicitly contained.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Human work is nested inside prior yield.** `ث م ر` B001 is ripe fruit and B003 benefit; `ع م ل` B001 intentional work; `ي د ي` B009 hands as one's act; `ش ك ر` B001 recognizes favor. The syntax keeps fruit, handwork, and the challenge to gratitude in one sequence. I infer that cultivation transforms provision but does not originate its life-bearing conditions. The ayah reads as a correction to exclusive ownership of production.
2. **Gratitude makes little provision visibly sufficient.** `ش ك ر` B002 is being sustained by little and showing its effect. The later animals, benefits, and drinks repeat the same question in 36:71-73. I infer that gratitude is a productive mode that manifests provision rather than a verbal afterthought. The ayah asks whether consumption will disclose its source in conduct.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:71-73 repeated human possession, use, and gratitude with livestock, confirming that handwork and ownership are delegated transformations inside prior provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Human hands operate downstream of a supplied ecology.** **ء ك ل B001** anchors ingestion; **ث م ر B003** gives **ثَمَرِهِۦ** the produced benefit; **ع م ل B001** supplies intentional work; **ي د ي B009** attributes acts to hands; and **ش ك ر B001** anchors recognition and display of favor. The preceding ayat supply enlivened ground, extracted grain, gardens, and burst springs before hand-work is named. The packet supplies that order; the inferred arrow is *human labor modifies or gathers a prior gift-chain rather than originating its enabling conditions*. Gratitude reads as correct causal attribution alongside work, not denial of work.
2. **Eating should make recognition visible.** **ش ك ر B002** supplies thriving on little provision and visibly showing its effect, while **ء ك ل B003** allows an allotted consumable share. The next ayah broadens production into created pairs, including kinds unknown to the eaters. The supplied contrast is consumed benefit versus incomplete knowledge; the abduction is *the body's visible thriving is evidence that should be converted into acknowledged dependence*. The question asks why benefit's effect appears in flesh but not in response.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:36 adds unknown created pairs, and 36:38–40 displays measured celestial operations beyond human making. These later relations widen the gratitude deficit: hands work inside an order whose paired limits they neither produced nor fully know.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Hidden substrate is opened, organized, and made repeatedly productive as water, crop, nourishment, and new life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Gratitude shares the agronomic logic of a field that turns a small input into visible increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harvest, handwork, and responsive increase
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Mature yield is eaten, shaped by deliberate handwork, and answered by a gratitude that itself resembles visible biological increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ripened fruit (quranic:root_000205:B001/m01); eating (quranic:root_000043:B001/m01); crop yield (quranic:root_000043:B002/m01); intentional work (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); manual workers (quranic:root_001046:B006/m01); deed attributed to hands (quranic:root_001693:B009/m01); recognition of benefit (quranic:root_000810:B001/m01); little input producing visible growth (quranic:root_000810:B002/m01); fresh shoots (quranic:root_000810:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fruit is both natural output and the terminus of intentional labor. Gratitude does not sit outside the production scene: its lexical image is a creature or plant that visibly flourishes from little provision, so acknowledgment becomes another form of responsive yield.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeme eylemini merkeze alırken yiyeceği, bir kerelik yeme veya lokmayı, çok yiyeni, birlikte yiyeni ve başkasını doyuranı da aynı anlam çevresinde toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı rolleri doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçek yeme çevresiyle sınırlıdır; ürün, mal, dedikodu ve başka benzetmeli kullanımlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış mal, ateş veya söz kullanımları bu kapsama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Besini ağız yoluyla tüketme eylemi ve bu eylemin doğrudan çevresindeki yiyecek, tek yeme, çok yiyen kişi, birlikte yiyen kişi ve başkasını doyuran kişi rolleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yiyeceği tüketme eylemidir.
Yenen şey, bir yeme keresi veya tek lokma da aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.
Çok yiyen, birlikte yiyen ve başkasını doyuran kişiler eyleme katılım biçimlerine göre adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, yeme eylemini temel alır ve yiyecek, tek lokma ya da yeme, çok yiyen, yemeğe eşlik eden ve doyuran kişi adlarını bu temel etrafında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem ile ona doğrudan bağlı nesne, kerelik ve kişi rollerinin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeme çekirdeğini, yiyeceği, tek kereliği ve katılımcı rollerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin besini tüketmesi anlatıldığında doğal eylem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Besini tüketme eylemini eksiksiz korur.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte yeme ilişkisini ve kişi rolünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mal kalıbında harcamayı ve özellikle hakka aykırı sarfı, kişi kalıbında ise başkalarının malını alıp onları sömürmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi bu iki yapı bağımlı kullanımı doğru korur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda malı harcama veya hakka aykırı yere sarf etme; kişilere yöneldiğinde ise onların malını alarak kendilerini sömürmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, malı harcama veya hakka aykırı biçimde sarf etme ile insanların malını alıp onları sömürme kullanımlarını kalıba bağlı olarak ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Malın sarf edilmesini ya da bir topluluğun malının alınarak sömürülmesini bildiren belirtilmiş kalıplarda uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin odunu yakıp tüketmesini, ateşe odun verilmesini, alevin şiddetlenmesini ve buna benzetilen öfke ile kılıç parıltısını destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki hoş koku, sürme ve gümüş örnekleri dal iddiasında bulunmadığından tanımdan çıkarılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ateşin tüketmesi, beslenmesi ve harlanması ile açıkça verilen öfke ve kılıç benzetmeleriyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ateşin şiddetlenmesini bildiren türemiş biçim ile ateş, öfke ve kılıç kalıpları ayrı tutulur; biri diğerine yalın anlam olarak yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin odunu yakıp tüketmesi, ateşe yakıt verilmesi veya alevin şiddetlenmesidir; aynı harlanma görüntüsü öfkenin kabarması ve kılıcın keskin parıltısı için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Ateş odunu yakarak tüketir.
Ateşe odun vermek, onu yakıtla beslemek olarak anlatılır.
Alevin şiddetlenmesi, ateşin kendi içinde büyüyüp harlanmasıdır.
Harlanma görüntüsü şiddetli öfkeye ve keskin kılıcın parıltısına aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ateşin odunu tüketmesi, ateşe odun verilmesi ve alevin şiddetlenmesi üzerinde birleşir; aynı görüntü öfkenin kabarmasına ve kılıcın keskin parıltısına taşınır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ateşin odunu yakması, ateşe yakıt verilmesi, alevin şiddetlenmesi ve açıkça belirtilmiş benzetmeli uzantılar birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tüketme, yakıt verme, şiddetlenme ve benzetmeli harlanma ayrımlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ateşin odunu yakarak ortadan kaldırdığı gerçek yanma bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakıt veren kişiyi, ateşi ve odun aracını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Öfkenin şiddetlenmesini ve harlanma benzetmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ateşin odunu tüketmesini, kendi kendine harlanmasını ve öfke ile kılıç uzantılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle odun ekleyerek ateşi güçlendirme ve bununla bir şeyi yakma eylemine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ateşe odun verilmesini ve yanmanın güçlenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem ateşin tüketici etkisini hem harlanma görüntüsünün uzantılarını taşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise ateşi odunla güçlendiren dış eylemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ateşi odunla güçlendirme en yakın sınırdır, öteki ateş dalları yalnız alev, yakma, kaynama veya köz karıştırma aşamalarına odaklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kaşıntıyı, bir şeyin aşınıp bozulmasını, diş çürümesini ve derideki ince kusurlu yeri destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki gebe devenin yavru tüyünden rahatsız olması yalnız ayrı sözcük birimi kanıtında bulunur ve dal iddiasını genişletemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kaşıntı, aşınma, bozulma, diş çürümesi ve derideki incelmiş kusurla sınırlıdır; ateş gibi parlamayı içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel aşınıp bozulma biçimleri ile diş ve deri kalıpları ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur; özel kalıplar yalın anlamı belirlemez.

concept_map.definition: Bedende kaşıntı; nesnede aşınıp bozulma; dişlerde çürüme ya da aşınma ve deride işlenince ortaya çıkan ince, kusurlu yerdir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin aşınarak bozulması veya bir bölümünü yitirmesi temel süreçtir.
Bedende ve başta kaşıntı biçiminde ortaya çıkabilir.
Dişlerde çürüme veya aşınma olarak görülür.
Deride dıştan sağlam görünen, işlenince kusuru beliren ince bir yer olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aşınıp bozulma çekirdeğini kaşıntı, diş aşınması ve işlenince kusuru beliren ince deri yeri gibi özel görünümlerle birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşınma çekirdeğini, bozulma sonucunu ve kaşıntı görünümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişlerde çürüme veya doku kaybı bulunduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Diş alanını ve aşınma sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yırtıcının avını ve yenmek için ayrılıp beslenen koyun ya da küçükbaş hayvanı destekler. Geçici çerçeveye eklenen yenmek için ayrılmış hurma ağacı yalnız ayrı sözcük birimi kanıtında yer aldığından dal tanımına alınamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yırtıcı tarafından avlanan canlıyla yenmek üzere ayrılmış küçükbaş hayvanı kapsar; genel yiyecek ve hurma ağacı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal av olmuş veya yenmek üzere ayrılmış canlıyı tanımlar; özel ağaç birimi bu genel tanıma aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yırtıcı tarafından avlanıp yenmiş ya da yenmek üzere ayrılıp beslenmiş canlı hayvandır.

facets.statement: Bir yırtıcının yakalayıp yediği canlı, onun avı olarak adlandırılır.
Koyun veya küçükbaş hayvan, üretim ya da satış yerine yenmek için ayrılıp beslenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yırtıcının avı olan hayvan ile soy veya satış için değil, yenmek üzere ayrılıp beslenen koyunu yenilme hedefinde birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kimsenin başkalarını arkalarından kötülemesini, onların saygınlığını zedelemesini ve bunu insan eti yeme görüntüsüyle anlatmayı açıkça destekler. Dal çerçevesi bu söz eylemini doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal doğrudan arkadan çekiştirmedir; söz taşıyarak kişiler arasını bozma ayrıca belirtilmedikçe buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız saygınlığa saldırma ve insan eti yeme görüntüsünü taşıyan verilen kalıplarda geçerlidir; yalın köke yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi arkasından kötüleyip saygınlığını zedelemek, bunu onun etini yemek görüntüsüyle anlatmaktır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek eylem, başkasını arkasından kötülemektir.
Eylem, kişinin saygınlığını veya etini tüketme görüntüsüyle ifade edilir.
Bu davranışı alışkanlık hâline getiren kişi de aynı kalıpla nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanları arkalarından kötülemeyi, onların saygınlığına veya etine saldırma görüntüsüyle anlatır ve bunu alışkanlık edinen kişiyi ayrıca niteler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin yokluğunda kötülenmesi ve saygınlığının sözle aşındırılması verilen kalıp içinde anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arkadan kötüleme eylemini, hedef kişiyi ve saygınlık zararını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiler arasında söz taşıyarak kışkırtmayı, aralarını bozmayı ve bunu yapan kişiyi açıkça adlandırır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu ilişki bozucu söz eylemini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birden çok kişi arasında söz taşıma ve ilişkiyi bozma kurucudur; tek kişiyi arkadan kötüleme tek başına yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kişiler arasını bozmayı bildiren verilen kalıplara bağlıdır; genel konuşma veya yalın yeme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kişiler arasında söz taşıyıp onları birbirine karşı kışkırtarak aralarındaki ilişkiyi bozmaktır; bunu yapan kişi de aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Kişiler arasında söz taşıyarak aralarını bozmak çekirdek eylemdir.
Eylem, tarafları birbirine karşı kışkırtmayı içerir.
Bu işi yapan söz taşıyıcı kişi de aynı yapı içinde adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlar arasında söz taşıma, kışkırtma ve ilişkiyi bozma eylemlerini birleştirir; bu işi yapan kişi ayrıca adlandırılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün kişiler arasında taşınması, tarafların kışkırtılması ve ilişkilerinin bozulması birlikte bulunduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Söz taşıma aracını, kişiler arası yönü ve bozucu sonucu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yemek yenilen kabı, iki veya üç kişiyi doyuracak çanağı, tencere ve kadeh türlerini, ayrıca yemek yenilen yeri açıkça kapsar. Dal çerçevesi bunları yeme eyleminin kap veya yer odağında doğru birleştirir.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.
